EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MAYOR OF THE BANDARAWELA MUNICIPALCOUNCIL UNDER SECTION 66B(2) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE(CHAPTER 262) AS AMENDED BY LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTION (AMENDMENT)ACT, No. 16 OF 2017
WHEREAS the office of Mayor in Bandarawela Municipal Council has fallen vacant by reason of Death ;

AND WHEREAS the Leader of the Independent Group No. 1 to which Naleen Priyantha Suriyage the formermember belonged, was required by me under Section 66 B (2) of the aforesaid ordinance, to decide upon the member ofthat Bandarawela Municipal Council who belongs to such Independent Group and who shall be declared elected asmember within a period of thirty (30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Leader of the Indepdendent Group has communicated his decision to nominate JanakaNishantha Rathnayaka to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE, I, H. I. R. Hathurusingha, Returning Officer of Bandarawela Municipal Council, acting interms of Section 66B(2) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) as amended by Local AuthoritiesElections (Amendment) Act, No. 16 of 2017 do hereby declare Janaka Nishantha Rathnayaka elected as Mayor of theBandarawela Municipal Council.
H. I. R. HATHURUSINGHA,Returning Officer,Bandarawela Municipal Council.
